p1: The day before Thanksgiving, 1971... a man in a black tie handed a flight attendant a note. It said he had a bomb.
He'd bought his ticket as Dan Cooper. Portland to Seattle. Flight 305.
He opened his briefcase. Inside: red sticks... and wires.
His demands: 200,000 dollars and four parachutes.
In Seattle, he traded the passengers for the cash and the parachutes.
Then he ordered the plane back into the sky.
A little after 8 PM, somewhere over the dark woods of southwest Washington, the rear stairs dropped open.
He jumped. Into the freezing night. In a business suit.
Nine years later, a boy found rotting bundles of 20 dollar bills, buried on a riverbank.
In 2016, the FBI stopped actively hunting him. Nobody knows who he really was.
